title: HEALING AND PLATING CANCEL RELOADS
why: His order: no bandage, medkit or plate at the same time as a reload, and every cancelled reload ends the active chain. Watch: no healing or plating while you reload. LOCAL: no linked review.
now: Medical use loses the reload clock and chain. R and empty-trigger reloads wait until medical use is done. Firing, rolling, sprinting, changing guns and going down cancel through one door.
